target.title: fix(models): preserve static provider catalog metadata
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes static provider catalog conversion so resolved runtime models keep schema-valid provider/model metadata.

## Problem

Static catalog providers can define provider-level request `params`, while individual model rows can define model-level `params`, `compat`, and `mediaInput`. The static catalog conversion path was not preserving that metadata consistently, so downstream model resolution and payload construction could lose information that other configured-provider paths already keep.

The concrete gap fixed here is provider/model metadata propagation in `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog`.

## Changes

- Merge provider-level and model-level `params` when building a runtime model from the static catalog.
- Let model-level `params` override provider-level defaults.
- Preserve model `compat` metadata on the resolved runtime model.
- Preserve model `mediaInput` metadata on the resolved runtime model.
- Add regression coverage for static catalog metadata preservation, tool-capability checks, and OpenAI-compatible payload construction.

## Validation

Focused local checks were run for the touched files:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`
- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`

## Scope note

This is limited to static provider catalog metadata propagation. It does not add a new config key, change session/tool policy, or depend on the separate live-session `Tool exec not found` investigation.
